items.q: Louie Armstrong was the first one to play that act. And Louie, in fact, made Brown and McGraw famous because their act was nothing without a trumpet.

ctx.x: They had a dance act, very fast dance act and I think their act lasted almost an hour. They also couldn't -- their act depended on the help of a trumpet player. Louie Armstrong was the first one to play that act. And Louie, in fact, made Brown and McGraw famous because their act was nothing without a trumpet. He blew them to death. Louie played to death for that act. Everything they did, Louie Armstrong was right on with the trumpet. So, after that, when they went out without Louie they had to have a trumpet…
